regions.merged_text: Thanks ... Mrs. Lena Holbath - 65 -(at 910 Kirby)- Episcopelian; was quite hopeless according to Drs. - had every thing in way of sickness .... unable to walk. If she stood on her feet for a min- ute the sweat ran down her body. She turned to Mary the Bl. Mother of Jesus .... and in two days was able to go to store and church etc.
